description:
K/W validation using independent regularized vortex-line quadrature.

The reference constructs the two rectangular surfaces analytically and does not
use the production mesh, influence kernels or circulation solver.

metadata.rule: max(ratio * local chord, current interval length)
metadata.scope: Lifting-surface interactions within one physical beam use zero core. Distinct physical beams and external probes/objects use the configured cores; images inherit the selected influence core.
